programmes.d: Clare receives crushing news while waiting for her MRI results. Needing time away from the hospital, Clare convinces Drew to help her escape.
Becky and her brother Luke’s relationship is very strained.

Why is Becky blowing Adam off to spend time with Todd? Who's Todd? Adam is not liking this long-distance relationship thing. Alli is falling hard for her Parisian waiter and worries maybe too hard too fast?
Maya can’t sleep. She’s having nightmares about Miles’ safety, and they’re becoming all too familiar.

Adam takes Dallas' advice and tries juggling two girls at once. But he's not that kind of guy. When upset Tristan goes AWOL in Paris, Maya enlists her sworn enemy for help find him and Alli continues to try and find balance in her relationships.
When Zoë lands her dream role, it hits a little too close to home following her assault.

Leo and Alli are getting to feel really serious. Distraught Drew needs to visit camp for comfort. Maya must show up Zoë and puts an expensive dress on her mother's credit card… nothing could possibly go wrong, right? !
Fireworks begin at Wild Wild West Night when Clare makes her decision known with regards to Drew and Eli.
Maya is doing her best to keep Zig safe but when she finds a bag of drugs, her worst fears are confirmed.
As summer comes to an end, Becky tries to understand the meaning behind an unexpected tragedy.
Hiding Zig out at the Matlin house while the Maya organizes the Art Night seems to be working… for now.

After the devastating loss of Adam, the Degrassi students try their best to move on but when it's your brother… And fitting in is hard for Zoë because she's never just been a normal girl. Alli reunites with Leo on her home turf.
Becky feels isolated at home since helping turn in her brother.

Drew does his best as Degrassi President but without sleep, he's not much good. By Drew's side, Zoë becomes the first lady of Degrassi. Leo does damage control and tries to get in with Alli's friends.
Drew was fired from the campaign, his friends think he’s a home-wrecker, and he’s in a fight with Dallas.
The opportunity to write for a real-life magazine is offered to Clare but her brain after cancer is not cooperating.
When Tristan asks Mr. Yates for some help, Mr. Yates suggests he come to his apartment for some extra help.
Clare tries to concoct any excuse to save her reputation with the magazine but doesn’t want to play the cancer card.
Tristan is warned by Mr. Yates to make his feelings about their affair less obvious at school.
Focusing more on her music than Miles, Maya lets Zoë talk her into making a sexy music video.
Zoë's trial begins and she fears that she is being painted in a harsh light.
The media is abuzz about Zoë’s trial.
Miles helps Maya discover who is behind her video going viral. Maya's hellbent on revenge, getting her into hot water.
Will a superstorm headed for Toronto stall a Degrassi dance?
Student council prez Drew is psyched about his Degrassi TV interview but when the story sheds a negative light, Drew’s stunned.
The Degrassi girls get together to dish on crushes, relationships, roommate drama and everything happening around school.
Drew is excited to have Bianca back in town for Thanksgiving but is surprised when she isn't as forthcoming as he expected.
Jane and the band try to get through rehearsal, but constant interruptions, relationship drama and unexpected advice keep getting in the way.
It’s Alli’s birthday, but all she can think about is Leo being sent back to France.
Alli is still lying to protect Leo, but her stories are beginning to unravel. Maya shows her rubber room classmates that she isn’t a princess.

Drew attempts juggling his new job and his new girl. To forget about Leo, Alli focusses on her science experiment. After getting thrown out of class for forgetting to wear a bra, Imogen plans a scathing piece for Degrassi TV.

Failing at balancing his life, Drew decides he has to break up with Zoë. Alli partners up with Dallas in an attempt to stay focused on her science experiment. Imogen takes her dress code fight online, but what does she really want to achieve?

A shocking discovery leads Miles to question his family life. Eli is slipping away, and Clare finds herself growing closer to Drew. Dallas wants to be with Alli, but the truth about her relationship with Leo could send him over the edge.
Miles is determined to out his father’s secrets, but he may not be ready for the whole truth.
With rumours swirling about Zoë’s drunken adventures at a recent party, Becky files a DTV report about teen girls and alcohol.

Becky wants to put things right after making a false accusation about Zoë's assault. But once she discovers the truth and sees how deeply this is affecting everyone, Becky questions if she's doing the right thing.

Maya tries to help Zig out of a tough situation. Jenna sets her sights on winning the semi-formal king and queen crowns with Connor. Becky worries she will lose Imogen as a friend when new student Jack arrives.
Becky tries to get back in bestie rhythm with Imogen at the semi-formal, but is there more to their relationship than friendship?
Dallas feels he's being racially profiled after he and Connor are held for questioning in connection with a terror incident.
Tristan confronts Mr. Yates about his harsh Drama class criticisms and finds out the shocking truth behind them.

When Zoë lands her dream role, it hits a little too close to home following her assault. Clare has some tough decisions to make as she searches for a date to Wild Wild West Night. Miles focuses on settling the score with Zig.
Fireworks begin at Wild Wild West Night when Clare makes her decision known with regards to Drew and Eli. Zoë struggles to stand up for herself. Miles and Zig face off in a showdown for Maya's heart.

Maya is doing her best to keep Zig safe but when she snoops and finds a bag of drugs, her worst fears are confirmed. Winston is on the prowl for his first ladyfriend when he realizes the perfect girl has been right under his nose for years.
Hiding Zig out at the Matlin house while the Maya organizes the Art Night seems to be working… for now. But will she be able to keep the gang away? Clare is deparate for answers from Drew.

Becky feels isolated at home since helping turn in her brother. Looking for a distraction, she finds her escape in online gaming. Drew’s excited for the last days of the Hollingsworth campaign but his charm gets him more than he bargained for.
Drew is in trouble! He was fired from the campaign, his friends think he’s a home-wrecker, and he’s even in a fight with Dallas.

When Tristan asks Mr. Yates for some writing help for his MC gig, Mr. Yates suggests he come to his apartment for some extra help. Imogen crushes hard on Jack and is determined to prove she can “roll” with her crowd.
Tristan is warned by Mr. Yates to make his feelings about their affair less obvious at school but Tristan can’t help it, he’s beaming.

Zoë's trial begins and when she fears that she is being painted in a harsh light, she takes matters into her own hands. Becky is torn up about what she’s going to say when she takes the stand as a character witness in her brother’s trial.

The media is abuzz about Zoë’s trial. Feeling hopeless and worried about her tarnished reputation, Zoë is nervous as the verdict approaches. Becky is torn about what to say in her testimony, but deep down knows what she has to do.
Will a superstorm headed for Toronto stall a Degrassi dance? Maya, Zig & Zoë plan to attend but get stranded at the Matlin house.

Clare is forced to spend the night with Eli while in New York City. Maya and Zoë seek refuge in The Dot with nothing to do but sort out their rivalry. Drew searches for missing Becky. Miles and Tristan share a bonding moment during the storm.
Clare has a serious dilemma that will affect her entire future and confides in Alli and Jenna.
Drew's not taking the easy way out - he's going to be part of his child's life, whether Clare wants it or not.
Frankie isn't a little girl anymore!
Clare has to muster up the courage to tell Eli about her situation.
Becky and her brother Luke’s relationship is very strained and even with her faith as strong as it is, she can't bring herself to forgive him.
Maya can’t sleep. She’s having nightmares about Miles’ safety, and they’re becoming all too familiar.
Zoë receives texts from an unknown number, threatening that they know the people behind the Power Squad’s scandalous fundraising initiative.
Tristan organizes an intervention for Miles, but it only pushes him further away.
Drew is committed to keeping Becky happy but his situation with Clare has his attention divided.
Mr. Simpson calls an assembly to address the offending fundraising website.
Degrassi's fundraising scandal threatens to ruin Frankie's relationship with her father.
